column3: “In order to agitate I in me” is rendered “Even because of my inward agitation”; the meaning is uncertain.
“The correction of my insult” is rendered “the reproof which insults me.”
“From when put humankind” is rendered “From the establishment of man.”
“People will not find him” is rendered “they cannot find him.”
“Will seek the favor of the poor” is rendered “favor the poor”; the meaning is uncertain.
“He spares it” is rendered “he desires it.”
“May he not look” is rendered “He does not look.”
The Hebrew is difficult; NASB renders “He returns what he has attained … He cannot even enjoy them.” The meaning is uncertain.
“Not he delivers” is rendered “He does not retain”; the meaning is uncertain.
NASB supplies “God.” “In his bowels” is rendered “while he is eating”; the meaning is uncertain.
“It will be evil a survivor in his tent” is rendered “It will consume the survivor in his tent.”
“Torrents” is rendered “His possessions will flow away”; the meaning is uncertain. “His anger” is capitalized as God's.
